description:
Job Location 
MANILA NET PARK OFFICE 
 Job Description 
 At P&G, your career is built to scale with our iconic brands like Ariel ® , Safeguard ® , Tide ® , Head & Shoulders ® , Old Spice ® , and Vicks ®. 
 
 Ready to join the team that powers our iconic brands? Here’s what you’ll be doing:
 
 The Fiori Horizontal IT Software Engineer will be a key member of our One team. We are seeking an experienced SAP Technical Consultant specializing in SAP Fiori development to support horizontal organizations + new demands + future envision. The role is responsible for the end-to-end delivery lifecycle including development, testing, implementation, cutover support, and hypercare activities across SAP landscapes.
 
 The candidate will collaborate with cross-functional teams, suppliers, security stakeholders, and IT operations to deliver scalable and sustainable Fiori solutions.
 
 The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in SAP Fiori/UI5, ABAP development, , SAP transport management, troubleshooting, documentation, and production support within enterprise SAP environments.
 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Document FIORI Organization Strategy / Envsion the future / Lead Central Finance Simplification Project – Fiori Space

 Develop custom SAP Fiori applications.

 Enhance and continuously improve existing Fiori applications.

 Develop standard list-based and custom Fiori analytical/reporting applications.

 Prepare technical designs, job aids, knowledge transfer documents, and supporting change management documentation for sprint deliverables.

 Provide Early Life Support (ELS), including knowledge transfer sessions, shadowing, and reverse shadowing activities.

 Coordinate with external suppliers, security SPOCs, and cross-functional teams to acquire and transfer process knowledge.

 
 Implementation & Deployment: 
 Prepare technical cutover and operational documentation for production deployment.

 Conduct handover activities to IT Operations and support teams.

 Provide post-go-live support during hypercare periods to ensure production stability.

 
 Universal Skills: 
 Strategy Thinking

 Learning Agility

 Problem Solving

 Communication

 Leadership

 
 Job Qualifications 
 Qualifications: 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field is required.S trong expertise in SAP Fiori/UI5, ABAP development, , SAP transport management 
 Hands-on SAP ABAP development, OData, CDS Views and enhancement experience.
 Demonstrated experience in software development and coding in various languages (C#, .NET, Java etc.).
 Excellent knowledge of software and application design and architecture.
 Familiarity with Agile development methodologies.
 Experience with software design and development in a test-driven environment.
 
 Scale your career with P&G 
 We provide avenues to scale your expertise and technological proficiency.
 
 As an experienced hire, you are empowered to scale your impact and go beyond being a developer with opportunities to lead, guide, and collaborate on transformative projects that power our brands.
 
 We are committed to scale your personal growth alongside the company’s success. Here’s what’s on the table:
 Performance bonus (STAR program) that rewards managers in light with business results achieved.
 Thrive at work and your personal life through our flexible work schedule with available work from home arrangements.
 Your well-being is non-negotiable and supported by health insurance, fitness support, and an Employee Assistance Program.
 
 Learn more about what’s in store for you at https://www.pgcareers.com/ph/en/benefits .
 
 About us 
 We produce globally recognized brands and we grow the best business leaders in the industry. With a portfolio of trusted brands as diverse as ours, it is paramount our leaders are able to lead with courage the vast array of brands, categories and functions. We serve consumers around the world with one of the strongest portfolios of trusted, quality, leadership brands, including Always®, Ariel®, Gillette®, Head & Shoulders®, Herbal Essences®, Oral-B®, Pampers®, Pantene®, Tampax® and more. Our community includes operations in approximately 70 countries worldwide.
 Visit  http://www.pg.com  to know more.
 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate against individuals on the basis of race, color, gender, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, citizenship, disability, HIV/AIDS status, or any other legally protected factor.

Full time
